title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Scratchy: Visual-Scratchpad Multimodal Reasoning for Cryptographic Proof Generation in EasyCrypt
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have recently made substantial progress in formal proof generation, yet presenting distinctive challenges in cryptographic area. Computational security arguments posit that a valid proof must coordinate probability, adversarial games, invariants, assumptions and bounds, which can be provided by a machine-checked framework named EasyCrypt. Although all objects may appear in available context, LLMs still struggle because proof-theoretic dependencies are typically implicit in a linear representation and distributed across multiple programs. So, this paper presents Scratchy, a visual-scratchpad approach that exposes these dependencies for multimodal generation. Given the natural-language security description, with formal context and target propositions, the proof objects can be normalized into a typed proof-relation graph. Then a structure-preserving visual compiler transforms the graph into the formula-rich visual proof state that guides a multimodal model in generating the EasyCrypt proof. Also, the Scratchy-eval, a 114-task dataset derived from reliable official EasyCrypt files, has been introduced. It contains 64 security-form proof generations and 50 multiple-choice knowledge tests. After a series of evaluations, covering semantic grounding, relational invariants, and game reductions, classical LLMs like GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 have gained a clear advantage from Scratchy's structured visual proof states. This contrast suggests that explicit proof structure can make the improvement and multimodal proof-state representation as a promising direction for computer-aided cryptography.
items.summary_zh: Scratchy 将密码学证明中的依赖关系编码为类型化证明关系图，再编译为可视化证明状态，引导多模态模型生成 EasyCrypt 证明；其评测集含 114 项任务，来源为官方 EasyCrypt 文件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 密码学证明的正确性可由 EasyCrypt 机械检查。该工作把模型输入结构与最终可检验的证明对象连接起来；但摘要没有给出具体通过率，能力提升幅度仍需结合完整评测核查。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）近期在形式化证明生成方面取得了显著进展，但在密码学领域仍面临独特挑战。计算安全论证要求一个有效证明能够协调概率、对手博弈、不变量、假设和界，而这些内容可由名为 EasyCrypt 的机器检查框架提供。尽管所有对象都可能出现在可用上下文中，LLM 仍然困难重重，因为证明论依赖通常隐含于线性表示中，并分散在多个程序之间。因此，本文提出 Scratchy：一种为多模态生成显式呈现这些依赖关系的视觉草稿板方法。给定自然语言安全描述、形式化上下文和目标命题，证明对象可被规范化为类型化证明关系图。随后，一个保持结构的视觉编译器将该图转换为富含公式的视觉证明状态，以引导多模态模型生成 EasyCrypt 证明。此外，本文引入 Scratchy-eval——一个由可靠的官方 EasyCrypt 文件构建的 114 任务数据集，其中包括 64 个安全形式的证明生成任务和 50 个多项选择知识测试。经过涵盖语义落地、关系不变量和博弈归约的一系列评测，GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 等经典 LLM 从 Scratchy 的结构化视觉证明状态中获得了明显优势。这一对比表明，显式证明结构能够带来改进，而多模态证明状态表示是计算机辅助密码学的一个有前景方向。
items.author_line: Yupeng Ren, Zhaoxuan Li, Rui Zhang

items.title: UniRRM: Unified Reasoning Reward Models Across Languages and Evaluation Paradigms
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) excels on tasks with verifiable rewards, but in open-ended tasks, the reliability of reward models remains a key challenge. Existing solutions either depend on costly proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge systems or opaque scalar reward models that lack interpretability. Recent works on generative reward models offer a promising alternative, but they remain constrained by static evaluation criteria, fragmented evaluation paradigms, and limited multilingual support. To address these challenges, we introduce MixReward, a large-scale multilingual dataset spanning six domains and 103 languages, containing both pairwise and listwise data, and propose UniRRM, a unified reasoning reward model supporting multiple languages and evaluation paradigms. UniRRM uses a staged reasoning chain to dynamically generate task-generic and instruction-specific criteria, enabling fine-grained, input-adaptive judgments while maintaining consistency across languages. Experiments demonstrate that UniRRM-8B and UniRRM-14B achieve performance close to the state-of-the-art for models of comparable size across multiple benchmarks, and are effective for unseen evaluation paradigms. In addition, ablation studies validate the reliability and effectiveness of UniRRM.
items.summary_zh: UniRRM 以覆盖 6 个领域、103 种语言的 MixReward 数据集训练统一推理奖励模型，支持成对与列表式评价，并通过分阶段推理链动态生成评价准则。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开放式任务的奖励可靠性会直接影响强化学习和模型比较。摘要报告了跨基准、未见评价范式及消融实验，但“接近同规模最优”的具体差距未在摘要中给出。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在具有可验证奖励的任务上表现出色，但在开放式任务中，奖励模型的可靠性仍是关键挑战。现有方案要么依赖昂贵的专有 LLM-as-a-Judge 系统，要么依赖缺乏可解释性的黑箱标量奖励模型。近期关于生成式奖励模型的工作提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但它们仍受制于静态评价准则、割裂的评价范式和有限的多语言支持。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了 MixReward——一个覆盖 6 个领域和 103 种语言的大规模多语言数据集，包含成对和列表式数据；并提出 UniRRM——一个支持多种语言和评价范式的统一推理奖励模型。UniRRM 使用分阶段推理链，动态生成任务通用和指令特定的准则，从而在保持跨语言一致性的同时，实现细粒度、可随输入调整的判断。实验表明，在多个基准上，UniRRM-8B 和 UniRRM-14B 对于同等规模模型取得了接近最先进水平的表现，并且对未见过的评价范式有效。此外，消融研究验证了 UniRRM 的可靠性和有效性。
items.author_line: Peng Lai, Yichao Du, Junchao Wu, Weibo Gao, Linan Yue, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Derek F. Wong, Guanhua Chen

items.title: CIT-CAD: Constraint Intent Tree-based CAD Code Generation and Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Natural-language Computer-Aided Design (CAD) code generation aims to turn design intent into executable and editable parametric programs. Large language models (LLMs) make this goal increasingly practical, but useful systems must preserve the construction process behind the rendered geometry. Existing benchmarks and methods mostly focus on how closely the generated CAD model matches the reference geometry, often using metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU). Such metrics can miss errors in part decomposition, construction hierarchy, Boolean operations, sketch structure, and geometric relations. This gap calls for a representation that makes design intent explicit and lets a system check generated code against that intent. We propose CIT-CAD, a framework that infers a Constraint Intent Tree (CIT) from the input description to represent the intended entities, hierarchy, operations, and relations. The tree has two roles: it guides CAD code generation and defines expected constraints for verification. The framework extracts actual constraints from the generated program, compares them with the expected constraints, and uses mismatches to localize and repair design violations. Experiments show that the framework improves CAD generation performance, with larger gains on more complex multi-entity designs. By turning design intent into an explicit and checkable object, this work is the first attempt to move text-to-CAD generation beyond rendered-geometry matching toward construction-aware synthesis, verification, and repair.
items.summary_zh: CIT-CAD 把文本设计意图表示为 Constraint Intent Tree，并将其同时用于 CAD 代码生成、约束比对、错误定位和修复，避免只按渲染几何相似度评价。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把可执行参数化程序的结构约束转化为可检查对象，适合检验模型是否真正保留了构造逻辑。摘要称复杂多实体设计上的提升更大，但未提供具体数值。
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言计算机辅助设计（CAD）代码生成旨在将设计意图转化为可执行、可编辑的参数化程序。大语言模型（LLM）使这一目标日益可行，但有用的系统必须保留渲染几何背后的构造过程。现有基准和方法大多关注生成的 CAD 模型与参考几何的接近程度，通常使用交并比（IoU）等指标。这类指标可能遗漏零件分解、构造层级、布尔操作、草图结构和几何关系中的错误。这一缺口需要一种能使设计意图显式化，并让系统据此检查生成代码的表示。我们提出 CIT-CAD，一个从输入描述中推断 Constraint Intent Tree（CIT）的框架，用于表示预期的实体、层级、操作和关系。该树有两种作用：引导 CAD 代码生成，并定义用于验证的预期约束。该框架从生成的程序中提取实际约束，将其与预期约束比较，并利用不匹配来定位和修复设计违例。实验表明，该框架提高了 CAD 生成性能，且在更复杂的多实体设计中增益更大。通过将设计意图转化为显式且可检查的对象，这项工作首次尝试使文本到 CAD 的生成超越渲染几何匹配，转向面向构造的合成、验证和修复。
items.author_line: Yali Du, Hui Sun, San-Zhuo Xi, Ming Li

items.title: CircuitLens: Reasoning Circuits as Data Selection Signals for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is sensitive to which problems a model trains on, yet existing selection criteria--difficulty filtering, hand-curation, reward-trajectory scoring--assess data value as an intrinsic property of problems, independent of the model that will learn from them. We introduce Circuit Reasoning Score (CRS), a selection signal derived from 46 reasoning-sensitive attention heads identified via contrastive ablation, computed in a single forward pass on the frozen base model without reward labels or rollouts. CRS runs against the intuitive hypothesis that stronger reasoning-circuit engagement produces better training data: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the lowest-engagement decile improves over random selection on three medium-difficulty benchmarks (GSM8K +2.0 pp, OlympiadBench +1.6 pp, Minerva +2.9 pp), while the highest-engagement decile gains less and is indistinguishable from the middle decile. The advantage has boundary conditions: on a domain-curated pool no selection method separates from the others; at 1.5B scale the useful direction differs; and the lowest-reward training condition produces the strongest downstream generalization. Within the Qwen2.5-Math settings tested, RLVR data selection appears regime-dependent rather than reducible to a static ranking of problem quality.
items.summary_zh: CircuitLens 以冻结模型中经对比消融识别的 46 个注意力头构造数据选择信号 CRS，并在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 RLVR 训练中检验其对数学推理泛化的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究报告了 GSM8K、OlympiadBench 和 Minerva 上的具体增益，也明确给出规模、数据池和奖励条件的边界，避免把机制信号表述为普遍有效的题目质量排序。
items.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对模型训练所使用的问题十分敏感，但现有选择准则——难度筛选、人工整理、奖励轨迹评分——将数据价值视为独立于将要学习的模型的问题内在属性。我们引入 Circuit Reasoning Score（CRS），这是一种从通过对比消融识别出的 46 个推理敏感注意力头导出的选择信号；它在冻结基座模型上仅需一次前向传播即可计算，无需奖励标签或 rollout。CRS 的结果与“更强的推理回路参与度产生更好的训练数据”这一直觉假设相反：在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，最低参与度的十分位组相较随机选择，在三个中等难度基准上取得提升（GSM8K +2.0 个百分点、OlympiadBench +1.6 个百分点、Minerva +2.9 个百分点）；最高参与度十分位组的增益较小，且与中间十分位组无法区分。该优势具有边界条件：在一个领域人工整理的数据池上，没有任何选择方法能与其他方法区分开；在 1.5B 规模上，有效方向不同；而最低奖励的训练条件产生了最强的下游泛化。在所测试的 Qwen2.5-Math 设置中，RLVR 数据选择似乎依赖于具体训练区间，而不能归结为对问题质量的静态排序。
items.author_line: Zhuofan Chen, Ziqian Jiao, Yikai Cui, Zhixin Cai, Jun Bai, Wenge Rong

items.title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs, localizing targets from directional language remains challenging, even when observer grounding is made explicit. We find that explicit breakdowns of observer-relative spatial reasoning improve target localization. Our project page is available at https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出 POVBench，将多视角三维场景中的观察者定位任务拆分为推断、明示和给定三种条件，以评估视觉语言模型的情境化空间推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基准的目标和输入输出关系清晰，并指出即使观察者视角被明示，方向性语言定位仍有困难；摘要未将该结果泛化为模型具备稳健三维理解。
items.abstract_zh: 在机器人等具身任务中，对语言指令进行推理通常要求从说话者所处的视角理解空间关系。人类会根据共享的环境知识、活动语境和常识推断此类视角。近期视觉语言模型（VLM）似乎能够进行空间推理，但它们能否从语境线索中推断说话者视点，并从该视点解释情境化空间关系，仍不清楚。我们将这种能力称为情境化观察者落地。为研究这一能力，我们构建了 Point-of-View Benchmark（POVBench），这是一个由三维场景和查询构成的数据集，用以区分具身自然交流中观察者落地的推断、明示和给定形式。给定多视角观察和一句自然语言语句，模型必须从情境化的空间与语境线索中定位未见或描述不足的目标。对最先进 VLM 的测试表明，即使观察者落地被明确给出，从方向性语言中定位目标仍然困难。我们发现，对观察者相对空间推理进行显式分解可改善目标定位。我们的项目页面位于 https://mimo-owl.github.io/POVBench/。
items.author_line: Mimo Shirasaka, Haochen Zhang, Yonatan Bisk

items.title: Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.
items.summary_zh: Deposon 为 LLM 推理路径建立由传输、反射和不可逆耗散组成的可审计散射账本，并明确报告其在真实基准上未优于简单关键词过滤器等负结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将机器精度下的守恒检查、预注册的合成陷阱测试与可证伪命题并列报告，且收缩了不被结果支持的动力学主张；其价值主要是审计性，而不是已证实的真实任务性能增益。
items.abstract_zh: 多步 LLM 推理缺少可由机器复查的账本：被舍弃的推理路径不会留下可审计记录。我们提出 Deposon 散射层，它将 LLM 生成的概念分解图中的每个节点绑定到一个双参数 Deposon 状态；路径经历三个通道的散射——透射、反射、不可逆耗散——并且对任意参数均满足 T+R+A=1，单条路径能量审计偏差最大为 2.2E-16（机器精度）。我们如实报告全部三层证据。在合成陷阱基准上，路径过滤增益是封闭的（预注册）：统一方法达到 100%，而诱饵捕获基线为 7%/10%。在真实基准上，该层与简单的六关键词规则过滤器无法区分（GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85，McNemar p=0.5；StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899）；这里没有检测到差异，因此我们将主张收紧为“差异化价值仅在于机器可验证性”。融合带来了第二个负结果：与语义先验的凸组合从未改善表现（physics 0.484 -> 0.452），而表面上的 lambda=2 增益是反场伪影；任何融合增益都必须是非线性的。将反向动力学建模为图上的势博弈后，我们为一个可审计标量的单调性和近似梯度性提供证据，并量化经验协调比（ECR）。三个形式化的动力学等价命题（P1a/P1b/T-P1c）在预注册的终止协议下被证伪，势博弈主张被降级为近似主张（循环图中位残差 0.669）：在动力学层面，只有一致性层面的证据得以保留。代码：github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon。

items.title: Certified Topological Interaction in Neural Representations: Class Disentanglement Is Mostly Pairwise
items.abstract_or_text: Class disentanglement (the separation of a representation's class-conditional point clouds along depth and over training) is usually read off descriptive curves. We measure it as certified topological interaction between labeled point clouds, using the recently introduced Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: the Euler characteristic of the overlap of the clouds' ball unions as a function of scale, computed by one Alpha-complex sweep with no boundary-matrix reduction. Every number carries a test: exact permutation tests in both directions, a guarded separation certificate, and a paired test for the comparative claims applications make. Across 111 trained networks and 52,650 certified measurements, disentanglement is depth-graded and concentrated in the first epochs, and interaction quotients rank class pairs by confusability (Spearman rho=0.83), on par with cheap separability statistics. In a 96-model factorial population, augmentation is the one training choice that separates classes relative to chance; weight decay compresses the overlap without separating, and depth and width do nothing. The structural finding is one only a k-fold statistic can pose: the joint entanglement of a class triple sits below that of its strongest pair in 97% of triple-layer cells and 99.5% of deep cells, far below a measured null floor, in vision encoders and frozen language models alike. This pairwise dominance is a regularity, not a law: expected from the nesting of overlaps but not forced by geometry, present at initialization and in raw pixels, and manufactured in the last stage alone when a network memorizes random labels. The unnormalized profile mass predicts test accuracy (R^2=0.94), the quotient does not, and neither beats a linear probe. One lesson is reported in full: the paired test must use a scale-free statistic, or it certifies feature-norm dynamics as disentanglement.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用 Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile 定量神经表示中带标签点云的拓扑交互，并对 111 个网络的 52,650 项测量使用精确置换检验和配对检验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它区分了统计显著的类别分离、表征范数变化与线性探针性能，并把“三类纠缠主要由最强的成对纠缠决定”明确表述为经验规律而非几何定律。
items.abstract_zh: 类别解缠结（表示的类别条件点云沿网络深度和训练过程发生分离）通常通过描述性曲线读取。我们将其测量为带标签点云之间经过认证的拓扑交互，使用最近提出的 Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile：作为尺度函数的云球并集重叠部分的 Euler 特征数，通过一次 Alpha-complex 扫描计算，无需边界矩阵约化。每个数值都带有一个检验：双向精确置换检验、受保护的分离证书，以及针对应用所作比较主张的配对检验。在 111 个训练好的网络和 52,650 项认证测量中，解缠结随深度分级，并集中在最初几个训练轮次；交互商按可混淆性为类别对排序（Spearman rho=0.83），与廉价的可分性统计量相当。在一个含 96 个模型的析因总体中，数据增强是唯一相对于随机机会能分离类别的训练选择；权重衰减压缩重叠但不造成分离，深度和宽度都不起作用。结构性发现只能由 k 元统计量提出：一个类别三元组的联合纠缠，在 97% 的三元组-层单元和 99.5% 的深层单元中低于其最强类别对的纠缠，远低于测得的零假设下限；这一结果在视觉编码器和冻结语言模型中都成立。这种成对主导性是一种规律，而不是定律：可由重叠的嵌套关系预期，但不受几何强制；它在初始化和原始像素中就存在，而当网络记忆随机标签时，仅在最后阶段被制造出来。未归一化的 profile 质量预测测试准确率（R^2=0.94），交互商不能，且两者都不优于线性探针。本文完整报告的一条教训是：配对检验必须使用无尺度统计量，否则它会把特征范数动力学认证为解缠结。

items.title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以答案分布轨迹而非终点准确率或熵曲线表征推理过程，并在 16 个开放权重模型和 4 个推理基准上比较不同轨迹动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将推理评估从单一终点扩展到可比较的预测分布演化；摘要报告同终点、相近熵的轨迹仍可不同，但这是一种分析框架，不等同于证明更强的数学求解能力。
items.abstract_zh: 思维链推理在模型输入和最终答案之间提供了结构化计算。然而，它通常通过终点准确率进行评估，忽略了到达答案所经历的路径。新兴的一类工作使用熵曲线来追踪推理过程中不确定性如何演化，以解决这一局限，但它们无法揭示哪些竞争性假设造成了这种不确定性。我们引入答案分布轨迹，这是一种受随机动力学启发的表示，用于追踪推理展开时模型关于答案的完整预测分布。作为比终点和熵摘要严格更精细的表示，答案分布轨迹使我们能够用涵盖探索、修订、运动和承诺的动力学推理剖面刻画一条轨迹，并区分推理成功和失败的不同动力学机制。在 16 个开放权重语言模型和 4 个推理基准上，我们表明，具有相同终点和相近熵曲线的轨迹可能呈现显著不同的推理动力学。我们还发现，这些动力学在模型和任务内部及之间均存在显著差异，不同目标偏好不同的动力学剖面。此外，我们表明训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些剖面。结果表明，答案分布轨迹为分析和评估 LLM 推理动力学提供了一个丰富框架。
items.author_line: Mar Gonzàlez I Català, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde, Davide Murari, Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb, Pietro Liò, George Montañez

items.title: Robust Conformal Consensus: Multi-Agent LLM-as-a-Judge Interval Evaluation with Conformal Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-as-a-Judge has emerged as a promising paradigm for evaluating natural language generation. However, the uncertainty associated with such evaluations remains largely unexplored, which limits their reliability in real-world applications. Although conformal prediction offers a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, existing approaches typically apply it to a single LLM judge, overlooking the variability introduced by using different LLM evaluators. In this work, we propose a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our approach constructs conformal prediction intervals for LLM-based scores from multiple LLMs. By considering intervals from different LLM judges, we obtain more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces valid prediction intervals with coverage guarantees, and that interval-based aggregation across multiple judges leads to more stable evaluation outcomes.
items.summary_zh: Robust Conformal Consensus 为多个 LLM 裁判的评分分别构造共形预测区间，再以区间聚合量化评价不确定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较只输出单点裁判分数，该方法的目标是可检验的覆盖率保证与跨裁判稳定性；摘要未披露实验数据集和具体覆盖率，因此结论应限于作者报告的评测范围。
items.abstract_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge 已成为评估自然语言生成的一种有前景范式。然而，这类评价相关的不确定性仍在很大程度上未被探索，这限制了其在真实应用中的可靠性。尽管共形预测为不确定性量化提供了有原则的框架，现有方法通常将其应用于单一 LLM 裁判，忽略了使用不同 LLM 评估者引入的变异性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于多智能体 LLM-as-a-Judge 评价的稳健不确定性估计框架。我们的方法为多个 LLM 的评分构造共形预测区间。通过考虑不同 LLM 裁判的区间，我们获得了更稳定、更可靠的不确定性估计。大量实验表明，该方法产生具有覆盖率保证的有效预测区间，并且跨多个裁判的基于区间的聚合带来更稳定的评价结果。

review.note: 入选 9 项：优先保留任务定义明确、具有可复核评测或形式化/统计保证的数学推理、证明生成与验证研究。未因候选分数而补足名额；仅有理论主张而未在摘要中说明可执行验证或评测结果的条目未入选。
